title: Executivo De Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito! Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Desafio

  • Vibram energia empreendedora : são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Responsabilidades

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região : percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica : realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda : acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar : participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B" e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação, Fortaleza - CE

Benefícios

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência.

Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago • Salvador, Bahia, Brazil

description:

A empresa é referência no uso de soluções de engenharia e tecnologia para gestão adm-fin. Garantir suporte qualificado à operação financeira da empresa, assegurando organização, confiabilidade e agilidade nas rotinas de controle financeiro, conciliações, acompanhamento de indicadores, recebíveis e fechamento contábil, contribuindo para a boa gestão financeira das obras e da incorporadora.

Atuar nas rotinas da área financeira, apoiando a organização e execução dos processos do dia a dia.

Realizar lançamentos, controles e acompanhamentos financeiros com precisão e disciplina.

Apoiar a manutenção da qualidade das informações financeiras da empresa.

Elaborar e atualizar relatórios financeiros e indicadores da área.

Acompanhar recebíveis, especialmente vinculados à CEF.

Apoiar o monitoramento financeiro das obras, consolidando informações relevantes para análise e tomada de decisão.

3) Interface com obras e demais áreas

Apoiar o acompanhamento financeiro das obras em articulação com as áreas envolvidas.

Contribuir para a organização de informações financeiras relacionadas à operação da construtora / incorporadora.

Manter boa comunicação com time interno para destravar demandas e apoiar a fluidez dos processos.

4) Organização, melhoria e apoio à gestão

Apoiar a estruturação de controles e rotinas da área financeira.

Contribuir com olhar crítico, raciocínio lógico e proatividade para melhoria dos processos.

Atuar com responsabilidade sobre prazos, qualidade das entregas e consistência das informações.

Requisitos

Graduação concluída ou em andamento em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão Financeira, Economia ou áreas afins.

Conhecimento prévio na área financeira.

Bom nível de Excel.

Boa capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico.

Perfil proativo, organizado e comprometido com a qualidade das entregas.

Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na sede da empresa.

Diferenciais

Experiência prévia em construtora e / ou incorporadora.

Conhecimento em Sienge.

Vivência com relatórios financeiros, conciliação bancária, acompanhamento de recebíveis e rotinas de fechamento.

Experiência com acompanhamento financeiro de obras.

Organização e disciplina para lidar com rotinas, controles e prazos.

Boa capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes.

Proatividade para resolver pendências e apoiar a área no dia a dia.

title: Implementation Analyst
description:
Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer

Equipment: Available upon request

Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000

About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.

About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

Java Application Support Engineer

We are looking for a strong Java Application Support Engineer to join our global Financial Services application support team, made up of team members in the United States, Brazil, and India. In this role, you will monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications. Relational Database experience with SQL, MySQL, Oracle SQL, or PL/SQL experience is preferred. Deployment experience using Jenkins is highly preferred. Our team works in an Agile Scrum environment with daily stand-ups and sprint meetings.

Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 5:00AM - 2:00PM BRT

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications
  • Debug software components, identify, fix, and verify remediation of code defects (own work and the work of others)
  • Support and maintain projects developed by the team and assist in production deployment and outages
  • Configure, deploy, debug, monitor, and document new system features and enhancements using Jenkins
  • Successfully communicate designs, research, and potential issues with team members
  • Collaborate with business professionals to determine functional and non-functional requirements for software development projects.
  • Participate in rotational 24x7 on-call 3rd/4th level support

Qualifications

  • Associate Degree, or, Technologo (Technologist) Degree, or higher is required.
  • 4+ Years of Java/J2EE application support experience
  • 2+ years of Relational Database experience
  • 2+ years of CI/CD tools (Jenkins)
  • 2+ years of experience on Linux platform
  • Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Design principles
  • Knowledge of the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Git, Maven, Jenkins, JIRA)
  • Excellent organizational skills, self-administration, attention to detail, multi-tasking, and effective prioritization
  • Strong interpersonal and English communication skills
  • Self‑motivated and able to meet objectives
  • Experience with the following technologies preferred:
  • Spring/Spring‑MVC/Spring Batch/Spring Boot is a plus
  • Tomcat, JBoss
  • REST Services, SOAP Services
  • Relational Database experience
  • JIRA & Confluence
  • Dynatrace & Splunk

This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 15-22k BRL/mo.

The Systems BA will assess the current‑state functionality, rewrite and modernize requirements using tools such as Claude Code, and support the transition to a more modern system. The role requires strong notetaking and documentation skills, the ability to ask the right questions during discovery, and clear translation of needs into actionable technical requirements for engineering teams.

Duration: 6-12 months with possible extension or FTE conversion.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst or Systems BA
  • Extensive experience writing technical requirements for system design and modernization efforts
  • Strong Jira experience, including creating user stories and development tickets
  • Experience using Claude Code or other AI tools to support system modernization
  • Ability to lead discovery sessions, ask probing questions, and provide thoughtful recommendations

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Experience working within education technology or healthcare-related applications

Salesforce System Analyst

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce System Analyst with 5 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in driving the optimization and enhancement of our Sales Cloud platform, ensuring seamless Salesforce migration, effective Salesforce administration, and robust system configuration and implementation. The Salesforce System Analyst will play a pivotal role in aligning our CRM capabilities with business goals, improving sales processes, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making across the organization.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage end‑to‑end Salesforce migration projects, ensuring data integrity and minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Perform comprehensive Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, security settings, and system maintenance.
  • Configure and customize Sales Cloud features to meet evolving business requirements, including workflows, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and translate them into scalable technical solutions within Salesforce.
  • Drive the implementation of new Salesforce functionalities and third‑party integrations to enhance system capabilities.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to maintain optimal platform efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation related to system configurations, processes, and best practices.
  • Provide training and support to end‑users to maximize adoption and utilization of Salesforce tools.
  • Stay updated on the latest Salesforce releases and industry trends to recommend innovative solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5 to 10 years of proven experience as a Salesforce System Analyst or similar role.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201), Salesforce Platform App Builder, or relevant advanced certifications are highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of Sales Cloud functionalities and CRM best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in Salesforce migration, administration, configuration, and implementation projects.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams and manage multiple priorities.

Tools and Technologies

  • Salesforce Administration tools and features
  • Salesforce Migration tools (e.g., Data Loader, Salesforce DX)
  • Salesforce Configuration and Customization tools (Workflows, Process Builder, Flow Builder)
  • Integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, REST/SOAP APIs)
  • Reporting and Dashboard tools within Salesforce
  • Version control and collaboration platforms (e.g., Git, Jira)

Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)

Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)

Location: LATAM

Duration: 6-12 months

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.
  • Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.
  • Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.
  • Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.
  • Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation.
  • Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.
  • Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud.
  • Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
  • Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem‑solving skills.

description:
A cada ano, o setor de saúde perde bilhões por falhas no faturamento. Nós somos o elo perdido que resolve esse gap com IA. Estamos em plena expansão, com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. Buscamos um Builder para transformar nosso produto atual em uma plataforma de escala global.

Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas; não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.

Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico: da mão no código à tomada de decisão. É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência :

  • O Agora (Execução e Precisão) :

Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.

Garantir precisão absoluta "batendo" dados e regras manualmente; em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.

Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.

  • O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura) :

Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais.

Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.

Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios, utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.

Curiosidade Investigativa : Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.

Atitude e Senso de Urgência : Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.

Mão no Código : Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).

Legado : você deixará o seu nome na construção, nos códigos e na história da empresa.

Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial : Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.

Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível : Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.

Flexibilidade e Futuro : Trabalho 100% remoto com possibilidade de participação societária (Equity) para quem constrói o negócio conosco.

Company Description

Upstream Capital is a tactical investor focused on growth‑stage technology companies, deploying both debt and equity to scale businesses. Headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, the firm has a global reach, with a proven track record of investing over $200 million in over 25 tech companies across Latin America, the Bay Area, and other regions. With deep expertise in the tech sector, Upstream Capital operates as a comprehensive finance platform leveraging knowledge, networking, data, and AI to drive success. The company is committed to partnering with innovative businesses, finding creative solutions to complex challenges, and aligning success between investors and investees for long‑term growth.

Role Description

The role is designed for someone who is deeply curious about how companies operate, how their economics work, and what are the patterns that make some of them thrive. The Intern will be exposed to the full investment process and encouraged to think critically about markets and capital allocation.

Beyond analytical work, we value people who enjoy engaging with the broader investment landscape. The role involves listening, asking good questions, forming independent views, and contributing ideas to internal discussions. Curiosity and judgment matter as much as technical skills.

Upstream operates in a lean, high‑ownership environment. Interns are expected to take responsibility for their work, explore opportunities proactively, and learn by doing. We look for individuals who are comfortable navigating ambiguity and who see feedback and mistakes as part of the learning process.

Candidates may come from any academic background. What matters is intellectual rigor, attention to detail, and a consistent pattern of high personal standards. Prior exposure to finance, consulting, or technology is a plus, but not a prerequisite.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in financial modeling and deep understanding of finance principles
  • Ability to communicate insights effectively through reports and presentations
  • Experience in, or knowledge of, the technology sector is a plus
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is strongly preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business administration, or a related field

About Us

Formerly known as Upload Ventures Growth, Upstream has the goal of becoming a platform for lifecycle investing in growth and late‑stage technology companies. The firm builds on Upload's track record of supporting global founders and leverages its experience in venture capital, technology, and data to identify, underwrite, and scale high‑performing businesses.

Upstream operates with a lean structure and a hands‑on approach. We value analytical rigor, operational discipline, and the ability to execute with precision in fast‑paced environments.

Mais do que um gestor de relacionamento, este profissional atua como parceiro estratégico do cliente: alguém capaz de compreender profundamente os desafios do negócio, antecipar necessidades, propor soluções de alto impacto e influenciar decisões em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão e Expansão de Carteira

    Gerir com autonomia e profundidade uma carteira de contas estratégicas, desenvolvendo planos de conta individualizados com metas claras de retenção, crescimento e aprofundamento de relacionamento.

    Identificar e estruturar oportunidades de up‑sell e cross‑sell de forma proativa, com base em análise de maturidade do cliente, consumo atual e potencial de expansão.

    Monitorar indicadores de saúde das contas (health score, NPS, churn risk, expansão de receita), traduzindo dados em ações táticas e planos de mitigação.

    Conduzir revisões periódicas de negócio (QBRs e EBRs) com stakeholders estratégicos dos clientes, apresentando resultados, road‑maps de valor e iniciativas conjuntas de crescimento.

  • Relacionamento e Influência Estratégica

    Construir e aprofundar relacionamentos em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos dentro dos clientes – operacional, gerencial e executivo – criando vínculos de longo prazo baseados em confiança e entrega de valor consistente.

    Posicionar‑se como consultor de confiança do cliente, antecipando necessidades, propondo iniciativas antes que sejam demandadas e participando ativamente de discussões sobre estratégia e resultados do negócio do cliente.

    Mapear e gerenciar o ecossistema de influenciadores e decisores de cada conta, desenvolvendo estratégias de engajamento customizadas por persona.

    Atuar como defensor interno do cliente, garantindo que as demandas e expectativas das contas estratégicas sejam priorizadas adequadamente pelas áreas de produto, operações e suporte.

  • Retenção e Crescimento de Receita

    Ser o principal responsável pelo atingimento das metas de Net Revenue Retention (NRR) e Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) da carteira sob gestão.

    Desenvolver estratégias de renovação antecipada e condução de processos de renegociação complexos, equilibrando flexibilidade comercial com preservação de margem e percepção de valor.

    Elaborar propostas comerciais estratégicas e materiais de apresentação executiva, com narrativa clara orientada ao ROI e ao impacto de negócio do cliente.

    Colaborar estreitamente com os times de Customer Success, Produto e Operações para garantir que a entrega sustente a percepção de valor e reduza o risco de churn.

  • Inteligência de Mercado e Contribuição Estratégica

    Monitorar movimentos competitivos, tendências de mercado e mudanças no ambiente de negócios dos clientes estratégicos, utilizando esse conhecimento para antecipar riscos e oportunidades.

    Contribuir com insights qualificados para o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas, ajustes de posicionamento e evolução de estratégias comerciais, a partir da escuta ativa e do relacionamento próximo com as contas.

    Reportar com consistência e precisão os KPIs de carteira para as lideranças, apresentando análises aprofundadas e recomendações estratégicas fundamentadas.

    Atuar como mentor e referência para profissionais de contas em estágios anteriores de carreira, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento do time e a evolução das práticas de gestão de contas da organização.

Competências Técnicas

  • Domínio avançado de CRM e ferramentas de gestão de carteira, com capacidade para estruturar pipelines de expansão, acompanhar health scores e gerar relatórios executivos com precisão analítica.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados de conta – consumo, receita, engajamento, risco – para transformar informações em estratégias de ação e narrativas de valor junto ao cliente.
  • Proficiência na construção de planos de conta (account plans) estruturados, incluindo mapeamento de stakeholders, análise de whitespace e definição de iniciativas prioritárias de expansão.
  • Capacidade de elaborar e apresentar materiais executivos de alto nível – QBRs, EBRs, propostas de valor e business cases – com rigor metodológico e clareza de comunicação.
  • Experiência com frameworks de gestão de contas estratégicas (SPIN, Challenger, MEDDIC, Miller Heiman ou equivalentes) aplicados ao contexto de expansão e retenção.
  • Fluência em ferramentas de comunicação, videoconferência e colaboração remota para condução eficaz de interações com clientes distribuídos geograficamente.

Perfil e Requisitos

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de contas estratégicas, Customer Success sênior ou vendas consultivas B2B com carteira de clientes de alto valor.
  • Histórico comprovado de expansão de receita em carteiras complexas, com métricas documentadas de NRR, up‑sell e cross‑sell.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com habilidade de interpretar dados de negócio, construir argumentos estratégicos e sustentar recomendações com evidências.
  • Habilidade de navegação em organizações complexas, com experiência em engajamento multi‑stakeholder e influência sem autoridade formal.
  • Capacidade de liderança e mentoria para contribuir com o desenvolvimento de profissionais de contas em estágios mais iniciais de carreira.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Visão de longo prazo e orientação estratégica – compreende que a gestão de contas é construída em horizontes de tempo, não em transações isoladas.
  • Inteligência relacional – lê dinâmicas interpessoais com acuidade, adapta o estilo de comunicação por interlocutor e constrói confiança com consistência.
  • Mentalidade de dono – assume responsabilidade integral pelos resultados da carteira, sem esperar que o ambiente externo dite o ritmo.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados – transita com naturalidade entre o relacionamento e a análise, usando ambos como instrumentos de criação de valor.
  • Proatividade estruturada – identifica oportunidades antes que se tornem óbvias e age com método, não por impulso.
  • Comunicação executiva – articula ideias complexas com clareza e precisão, tanto no nível operacional quanto no estratégico.
  • Resiliência e estabilidade emocional – mantém qualidade de presença e raciocínio em situações de pressão, renegociação e complexidade.

Job Description

The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi‑Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5G, satellite and edge for mining.

Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial IoT, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting a multicultural and multifunctional environment.

Main Responsibilities

Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission‑critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/IoT and cloud/hybrid operations.

Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.

Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD‑WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.

Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.

Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.

Our client is a global investment and operating group focused on acquiring and growing technology-driven businesses. With a long-term ownership approach, the organization partners with companies to support sustainable growth, operational excellence, and value creation over time.

The group operates through a decentralized model, bringing together a diverse set of businesses across multiple geographies and industries. Each company retains a high degree of autonomy, while benefiting from shared expertise, strategic guidance, and disciplined capital allocation.

In Brazil, the organization is experiencing a strong growth phase, driven by ongoing acquisitions. This expansion brings both opportunity and complexity, particularly in strengthening leadership capabilities and ensuring consistent performance across independently operated businesses.

Purpose of the Position

As the organization continues to expand through acquisitions, this role has been created to strengthen leadership capability and talent scalability across its businesses. Operating at the intersection of growth and integration, the position focuses on shaping and advancing a talent strategy that supports long-term performance, leadership continuity, and organizational resilience.

Based in Brazil, the role will initially support the local group of businesses, while being designed with a broader, multi-entity mandate and the potential to expand across Latin America over time.

This is a highly strategic position centered on designing and evolving talent architecture across multiple business units, rather than focusing on the execution of established HR programs within a single organization. Working within a decentralized and lean environment, the individual will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing key decisions related to leadership, succession, and organizational effectiveness.

Impact will be driven through influence, coaching, and the ability to leverage existing HR and business resources, rather than through a large, dedicated team. Over time, success will be reflected in stronger leadership pipelines, scalable succession frameworks, and a measurable reduction of leadership risk, particularly in post-acquisition environments.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Build and embed scalable talent frameworks across a diverse and growing group of businesses
  • Address leadership gaps following ownership transitions, ensuring continuity and long-term readiness
  • Influence senior stakeholders across decentralized business units
  • Support sustained growth by aligning talent strategy with ongoing expansion
  • Assess and integrate leadership and talent in newly acquired companies
  • Implement data-driven approaches to talent and workforce decisions
  • Deliver impact in a lean, influence-based operating model
  • The role does not oversee daily HR operations or business unit-level execution

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in HR, talent strategy, and / or business leadership roles
  • Proven experience designing and scaling talent strategy across complex environments
  • Exposure to multi-business or matrix structures
  • Strong experience influencing senior stakeholders (C-level / business leaders)
  • Background in high-growth, transformation, or M&A-driven environments
  • Experience with due diligence and integration from a people perspective
  • Data-driven mindset with experience leveraging workforce insights
  • International exposure and cross-cultural experience
  • Experience beyond traditional HR expected, exposure to enterprise-level talent strategies
  • Background that includes enterprise-level or strategic talent initiatives
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree is a plus
  • Fluent English required; Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus

Behavioral Skills

  • Strategic and business-oriented mindset
  • Strong executive influence and stakeholder management
  • Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity
  • Focus on building scalable solutions
  • Ability to drive results through influence

Additional Information

No direct team initially; impact is driven through influence and leverage of existing resources

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in‑house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don’t trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi‑step, tool‑using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research‑adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non‑engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real‑world, high‑stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in‑house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don’t trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi‑step, tool‑using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research‑adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non‑engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real‑world, high‑stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

description: Senior Product Manager – Digital Acquisition (Nike Brasil | Grupo SBF) Seu Desafio Não buscamos um\ "piloto de backlog\", mas um PM com olhar empreendedor e profundidade no negócio. Influência e Educação: Atuar como um agente que eleva a maturidade digital da organização, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções tecnológicas escaláveis. O Perfil que buscamos 1. Visão de Negócio & Estratégia: Você mergulha no segmento, entende de marketing, economia e negociação. Consegue encontrar brechas no mercado e transformá-las em vantagem competitiva. 2. Capacidade Analítica\ "Data-Informed\": Saber dizer\ "não\" é sua maior ferramentade priorização. Você usa dados (quant e quali) para convencer, inferir o tamanho de oportunidades e validar hipóteses. 3. Execução e Senso de Urgência: O varejo não espera. Precisamos de maestria na execução, foco e dedicação. Aqui, trabalhamos com velocidade, inteligência e sem acomodação. 4. Mentalidade AI Native: Você utiliza IA como ferramenta fundamental no dia a dia — seja para acelerar análises, escrever queries no BigQuery ou estruturar narrativas. 5. Articulação Cross-functional: Constrói relacionamentos sólidos com Engenharia, Design e Mídia, movimentando pessoas em prol de uma visão comum. Requisitos Sólida experiência como PM Sênior, preferencialmente em Growth ou Aquisição Digital. Conhecimento técnico e estratégico em SEO, navegação e experiência de busca. Familiaridade com o stack de dados: GA4, Search Console e SQL (BigQuery). Habilidade de validação ágil: Saber gerar valor desde o\ "dia zero\", validando ideiasde forma rápida (muitas vezes sem código). KPIs: O que define o seu sucesso? Receita incremental atribuída à aquisição. Qualidade de visualização de Grid e PDP. Volume e conversão de sessões orgânicas. Retenção de tráfego (Return Visitors). Por que essa vaga? Se você tem senso de ownership, não se contenta com o básico e quer liderar o digital da maior marca esportiva do mundo dentro de um ambiente de varejo competitivo e dinâmico, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Account Manager
description: Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, people-first Account Manager who can build lasting client relationships, keep projects moving, and make sure every client feels informed, supported, and confident every step of the way. About Us Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an\ "unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between. Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading. What You'll Do Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships, setting expectations, and delivering excellent service at every touchpoint. Translate client marketing goals into clear, actionable tasks, and coordinate with the Marketing Coordinator for execution. Lead regular client meetings, share updates and deliverables, and ensure everything stays aligned with client expectations. Use Jiminny to document meetings, capture key takeaways, and package notes, action items, and recordings using our meeting template. Review final deliverables before submission to ensure quality, relevance, and client readiness. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts to strengthen collaboration and drive long-term success. Handle client concerns and dynamics with professionalism, composure, and emotional intelligence. What You Bring 2+ years of experience in account management, client services, or a similar client-facing role. Clear, confident communication skills, you can manage expectations, present deliverables, and handle tough conversations without breaking a sweat. Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple clients, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously. A strategic mindset, you connect client goals to the bigger picture and collaborate with senior team members to get there. High emotional intelligence, you read the room, stay composed under pressure, and build trust naturally. Proficiency using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to improve workflows, streamline communication, and enhance overall efficiency. Copywriting experience, you can craft clear, on-brand messaging and support content needs when required. Experience in a digital agency or marketing environment is a strong plus. Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Bonus Points Familiarity with project management or CRM tools. Experience presenting creative or marketing work to clients. Background in digital marketing, understanding what your team is building makes you a better advocate for your clients. Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Reports to the Director of Accounts Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you're someone who genuinely loves building relationships, thrives on keeping things organized and on track, and takes pride in making clients feel like they're in the best hands, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

description: JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE, you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus! Responsibilities: Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope. Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery. Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts. Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization Requirements: 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms) Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery) Why Join JoVE? You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. What We’re Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience. Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager
description: About us: At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote roles with US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders. Overview: One of our fast-growing US clients is looking for a versatile SEO marketer with a strong Growth foundation and proven experience running B2B campaigns. In this role, you'll own the search strategy, drive measurable pipeline growth, and support high-impact marketing initiatives across the funnel. You’ll spend your time on SEO (including AI-driven SEO). From improving rankings on Google and LLMs to measuring campaign performance, you’ll be responsible for identifying the biggest opportunities, creating a plan, and executing quickly. This is a high-agency, high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants room to grow. Responsibilities: Own and evolve the SEO strategy to improve rankings, visibility, and conversions across both Google search and large language models. Conduct keyword research, optimize on-page content, lead technical SEO improvements, and run AI-SEO experiments. Report weekly on performance, key insights, and recommended actions. Write high-converting copy for ads, landing pages, and growth experiments. Support awareness and demand-gen initiatives, including webinar promotion, content refreshes, and campaign execution. Collaborate closely with the Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to execute cross-functional growth projects. Skills & Qualifications: 5+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2B environments. Proven success in SEO, including technical SEO, content optimization, and AI-driven SEO strategies. Proficiency with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or equivalents. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Strong copywriting ability, especially for ads and landing pages. High ownership mindset, you prioritize effectively, execute independently, and move fast. Nice-to-Haves: Startup experience or comfort operating in fast-paced environments. Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page optimization.

title: Account Manager
description: Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, people-first Account Manager who can build lasting client relationships, keep projects moving, and make sure every client feels informed, supported, and confident every step of the way. About Us Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an\ "unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between. Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading. What You'll Do Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships, setting expectations, and delivering excellent service at every touchpoint. Translate client marketing goals into clear, actionable tasks, and coordinate with the Marketing Coordinator for execution. Lead regular client meetings, share updates and deliverables, and ensure everything stays aligned with client expectations. Use Jiminny to document meetings, capture key takeaways, and package notes, action items, and recordings using our meeting template. Review final deliverables before submission to ensure quality, relevance, and client readiness. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts to strengthen collaboration and drive long-term success. Handle client concerns and dynamics with professionalism, composure, and emotional intelligence. What You Bring 2+ years of experience in account management, client services, or a similar client-facing role. Clear, confident communication skills, you can manage expectations, present deliverables, and handle tough conversations without breaking a sweat. Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple clients, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously. A strategic mindset, you connect client goals to the bigger picture and collaborate with senior team members to get there. High emotional intelligence, you read the room, stay composed under pressure, and build trust naturally. Proficiency using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to improve workflows, streamline communication, and enhance overall efficiency. Copywriting experience, you can craft clear, on-brand messaging and support content needs when required. Experience in a digital agency or marketing environment is a strong plus. Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Bonus Points Familiarity with project management or CRM tools. Experience presenting creative or marketing work to clients. Background in digital marketing, understanding what your team is building makes you a better advocate for your clients. Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Reports to the Director of Accounts Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you're someone who genuinely loves building relationships, thrives on keeping things organized and on track, and takes pride in making clients feel like they're in the best hands, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist AdLib is looking for a DSP Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist to support our brand and agency partners by ensuring flawless campaign setup, trafficking, QA, and delivery execution across multiple programmatic platforms. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience implementing and maintaining campaigns across DSPs like BeesWax, Yahoo, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, and similar. What You’ll Be Doing - Execute end-to-end trafficking and setup across multiple DSPs, including QA and launch readiness.
- Manage pacing and delivery to ensure budgets and flight dates remain on track.
- Perform detailed QA across targeting, creatives, tracking, and measurement prior to launch.
- Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues, tracking errors, creative rejections, and platform-level discrepancies.
- Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaigns are implemented correctly and on time.
- Maintain accurate documentation, naming conventions, and operational workflows across platforms.
- Support reporting needs by ensuring campaign data is consistent and properly structured.
- Stay up to date on DSP requirements, ad operations best practices, and evolving programmatic standards. Whats You Bring - 2+ years of experience in ad operations, trafficking, or execution across multiple DSPs (BeesWax, Xandr, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, etc.).
- Strong understanding of trafficking workflows, pacing, and QA processes in programmatic advertising.
- Experience troubleshooting delivery, tracking, and technical issues across platforms.
- Familiarity with analytics and measurement tools such as Northbeam, Triple Whale, Appsflyer, and Google Analytics is a plus.
- Detail-oriented mindset with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to manage multiple active campaigns in a fast-paced, remote work environment. What We Offer Competitive salary (dependent on region) Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits Unlimited PTO Flexible, remote-first culture Coworking space allowance Gym membership reimbursement Mobile phone plan reimbursement Join us at AdLib and help agencies and brands scale their programmatic media buying smarter, faster, and more profitably

title: Go High Level (Ghl) Intern
description: Calling All Awesome Marketing Interns!!! We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented GoHighLevel (GHL) Marketing Intern to support the growth of our vacation rental management business. This role is ideal for someone who wants hands-on experience in funnel building, landing pages, and performance marketing. The program is a 3-month remote internship, during which you will assist in fulfilling various digital marketing tasks for your mentioned business for 10 hours per week. This is an unpaid program whose end goal is to provide students with a higher chance of getting hired in the digital marketing space after completing our apprenticeship program. Check with your school's Internship Coordinator BEFORE accepting the hiring offer to determine if this position satisfies the criteria for receiving academic credit. What’s In It For You? It’s (100%) fully remote position and offers flexibility in schedule. You’ll have clear goals and the training resources you need to deliver. Access our free courses on the platform that you can finish at your own pace. 1 to 2 hours of mentorship every week. Issued certification upon successfully completing the program. Boost your portfolio and grow your professional network Get to utilize and elevate your digital marketing skills in real projects You have a high chance of being hired by your mentor during or after the apprenticeship, depending on your performance. Key Responsibilities: Update and optimize our existing GoHighLevel website for a vacation rental management company Collaborate with the business owner and marketing coach to implement pre-planned funnel pages and campaigns Build and maintain high-converting landing pages for vacation rental properties (with scalable/duplicable templates) Ensure all pages are fully functional, user-friendly, and properly tracking traffic sources (especially Facebook Ads) Support customer acquisition efforts by coordinating email marketing and Facebook ad campaigns already in place Monitor and optimize campaign performance to improve guest conversion and increase direct bookings Implement additional marketing strategies on the website (e.G., blog pages, service pages) Provide recommendations to improve website traffic, lead generation, and conversion rates Ensure consistent website experience across all traffic sources, including referrals from partner platforms (e.G., tourist bureau listings) Qualifications: Basic experience or strong interest in GoHighLevel (GHL) Familiarity with landing pages, funnels, and digital marketing concepts Understanding of Facebook Ads and email marketing (hands-on experience is a plus) Strong attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot page issues Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively Self-starter with a willingness to learn and take initiative Nice to Have: Experience in vacation rental, hospitality, or real estate marketing Basic knowledge of SEO and content marketing (blogs, service pages) Experience with analytics and tracking tools About us: Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. Acadium gives anyone the tools, support, and mentorship they need to launch their dream career. Acadium is the only platform that provides real work experience, accessible to everyone. Acadium began in 2017 with a team of 3 co-founders: Richard Shaw, Marco Tundo, and Moe Abbas. Since then, they’ve attracted more than 120,000 student members and over 50,000 businesses to connect through the apprenticeship marketplace. Our team is growing and looking for people who are motivated, intelligent, and committed to making education accessible to join our team. What We Value: Integrity - Be trustworthy in your actions Care - Treat your teammates and our community as you would want to be treated Curiosity - Ask questions. Always state your assumptions Tenacity - Persevere when times are tough Discipline - Be consistent in your actions Ambition - Aspire to become better every day Service -Serve your community to the best of your abilities.

title: Lifecycle & Retention Strategist (Klaviyo)
description: ABOUT ATTN AGENCY ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue. We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth eCommerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight. You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue. You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale. This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes. SCOPE OF WORK Strategy and Campaign Planning Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth eCommerce brands Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and ClickUp timelines on track Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities Optimization and Performance Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training Tech Stack Management and Recommendations Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.Io, LoyaltyLion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, AfterShip), push notifications, and direct mail (PostPilot, PaperRun, etc.) Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team Client Collaboration Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within eCommerce or DTC Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response Solid understanding of the eCommerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment Proficiency with ClickUp (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite NICE TO HAVE Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel Experience mentoring or managing junior team members Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud HOW WE WORK You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through ClickUp for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

Capacidade de conduzirreuniões e workshops;
Senso de prioridade e foco em geração de valor para o cliente. Nossos benefícios: Cartão benefício Flash com vale refeição de R$30,00/dia;

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description: About FirstIgnite FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production. The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company. What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the rightprincipal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests. Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results. Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. title: Gerente De Segurança Da Informação
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG.
